amendment_rule: Any change to a strategy's definition, sample window, constants or grading rule creates a NEW version with a new registration commit and resets its out-of-sample count to zero. The list below is empty at registration and records errata that do NOT change a forecast: a documentation sign note and a duplicate-game merge are errata, not amendments.

amendments.text: The registration's parenthetical '(negative = home favoured)' contradicted the formula beside it. The engine has always used E_home - E_away (positive = home favoured); the note is corrected in the appended erratum section and no constant, rule or forecast changed.

The constant sample merged the verified corpus with the Week 10 transcription and double-counted the Thursday game present in both (149 vs 148 reconciled games). The merge is keyed on date/away/home, the overlap is reported on the page, and the build asserts the constant sample equals the reconciliation count. HFA and sigma were re-estimated at n=148 before any Week 11 game existed; no Week 11 forecast was graded or changed.
amendments.affects_forecasts: no -- Week 11 had not kicked off (first game 2026-11-19)

forbidden: publishing a backtest number as a leaderboard rank
multiplying marginal probabilities to price a combo
a fixed points penalty for an absent starter
deriving depth order from jersey number, experience or salary
